note: DEC-0011 to DEC-0015 approved by User on 2026-10-03 as part of the P2 research approval.

decisions.title: Adopt AGENTS.md as the SPS project-local instruction surface
decisions.decision: SPS emits AGENTS.md plus adapter translation rather than defining a new instruction file.
decisions.reason: Five competing harness-specific instruction files exist; AGENTS.md is the convergent standard and is now stewarded under the Linux Foundation.

alternatives.rejected_because: It would add a sixth competing format and reduce portability.

approval.basis: Explicit user approval of the P2 research and audit phase, 2026-10-03. Bound to P2 research only.

decisions.title: Hooks are an optimisation, never the enforcement layer
decisions.decision: Governance gates are validators that refuse transitions; hooks may accelerate them but are never load-bearing.
decisions.reason: Hook support is partial or unknown across harnesses, so load-bearing enforcement would fail silently wherever hooks are unavailable.

alternatives.rejected_because: Would make correctness depend on uneven harness hook support.

approval.basis: Explicit user approval of the P2 research and audit phase, 2026-10-03. Bound to P2 research only.

decisions.title: MCP registry provenance adopted, security role rejected
decisions.decision: SPS mirrors reverse-DNS namespace provenance for capability records and performs its own security evaluation.
decisions.reason: The registry explicitly delegates security scanning and does not scan server code.

alternatives.option: Treat registry listing as a security signal
alternatives.rejected_because: The registry documents that it performs no code scanning.

approval.basis: Explicit user approval of the P2 research and audit phase, 2026-10-03. Bound to P2 research only.

decisions.title: Do not encode unverified numeric thresholds in any verifier
decisions.decision: LCP and INP thresholds remain RESEARCH_FURTHER until observed from an official source.
decisions.reason: The thresholds could not be retrieved during P2; encoding an assumed value would repeat the legacy documentation-as-proof failure.

alternatives.option: Encode commonly cited threshold values from memory
alternatives.rejected_because: Unverifiable from the consulted sources; prohibited by the no-assumption requirement.

approval.basis: Explicit user approval of the P2 research and audit phase, 2026-10-03. Bound to P2 research only.

decisions.title: Continuous learning becomes evidence-gated proposal only
decisions.decision: Automatically extracted patterns may be recorded as proposals but never become binding policy without explicit user approval.
decisions.reason: Self-reported confidence is not independent evidence, and self-modifying governance would violate the no-silent-inference requirement.

alternatives.option: Adopt instinct-based learning with confidence scoring
alternatives.rejected_because: Self-scored rules bypass user approval and generalise poorly across projects.

approval.basis: Explicit user approval of the P2 research and audit phase, 2026-10-03. Bound to P2 research only.
